title: daily interest posting of the discriminating savings account (id 2)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture savings-account-daily-raw.json (GET account read-back, tenant gerege). request.daily_interest.balance_minor="100000" is the integer minor-unit form of the deposit the account holds (1000.00 MNT, transaction id 4 amount 1000.000000); request.daily_interest.rate_per_annum_micro_pct=182500 is the savings Percent (micro-per-cent) form of the account's nominalAnnualInterestRate 0.182500; request.daily_interest.days_in_year=365 is the product's 365-day year convention (product id 3); request.daily_interest.days=1 is the one-day accrual the MANIFEST records as the discriminating input. expect.interest_minor="1" is the integer minor-unit form of the interest posting the oracle wrote back (transaction id 5 amount 0.010000, the HALF_UP rounding of the raw daily interest 0.005). Nothing was computed by this promotion.

provenance.note: The expected interest cell is transcribed from the committed capture savings-account-daily-raw.json; capture_case_id names the savings product name value of the observed account.
